hypothesis: V2 improves relational ordering on synthetic Train while degrading locked Dev, and expanding encoder adaptation in V4 does not help. Freezing the encoder should preserve incumbent representations and allow only the classifier head to absorb Target-First supervision, reducing scenario-pattern overfit while retaining any transferable label-boundary adjustment.

protocolVerification.requiredOnlyMaterialChange: trainable parameters classifier plus encoder layers 10-11 -> classifier only

exactChangeFromV2: trainable parameters only: classifier and encoder layers 10-11 -> classifier only
finalPolicy: No Final Test file reads, inference, error inspection, tuning, or model-selection use.

training.checkpointRule: save and evaluate the final one-epoch checkpoint only

loss.bceReduction: mean over unmasked Product-18 cells within each row
loss.ranking: mean softplus(z_plausible - z_selected) over the within-row Cartesian product
loss.rowReduction: L_bce + lambdaRank * L_rank, then unweighted batch mean

stoppingAndSelectionRule: one epoch; final checkpoint only; KEEP_CANDIDATE only on all nine unchanged Dev gates, otherwise REJECT_CANDIDATE; no restart or rescue run

expectedMeasurableEffect.primary: Dev P0 raw-ranking Macro and selected-above-plausible remain at least incumbent-like rather than reproducing V2 degradation
expectedMeasurableEffect.secondary: Target-First classifier-head adaptation improves Train relational margins and Dev Macro-F1 without violating the unchanged FP guard
expectedMeasurableEffect.failureCondition: Dev P0 raw ordering remains at V2 or below incumbent despite encoder freezing
